# Third-party validation material

Frama-C Manganese preprocessing evidence retains model-header declarations and
original copyright/license comments. These headers use LGPL-2.1 and remain under
that license. The accompanying Debian copyright file identifies upstream and
component terms. Original toolkit code remains Apache-2.0.

Corresponding upstream release source:
https://www.frama-c.com/download/frama-c-25.0-Manganese.tar.gz
Debian source package: frama-c 20220511-manganese-3, bookworm.
The evidence is generated from the unmodified installed model headers using
Clang preprocessing with comments retained; the resulting `.i` source is
included with its native run. No Frama-C executable is redistributed.
